notes.title: Ways V1.2 (Update 2) - 01/06/2025
notes.notes:
Bug fixes :
- Fixed a bug that caused an item to disappear after the player's death.
- The camera bug after player death has been resolved.
- The bug that caused the flashlight to disappear has been fixed.
- Other minor bugs have been resolved.

Additions / Deletions :
- An overlay appears on certain objects to help the player interact.
- Addition of an arrow in the elevator on level 2.
- Addition of sound effects in level 0.
- Addition of sound effects in the Hotel.
- Addition of a new puzzle in ventilations
- The maintenance room on level 2 has been modified.
- Credits have been modified and are now available in-game.
- A new room has been added on level 2.
- Added indications of directional movements for the player.
- The electric box puzzle on level 2 has been slightly modified.
- Monster speed in level 4 has been slightly reduced.

Other :
- Some sound effects have been modified.

And happy new year to all!
